title: E-SPN-0065: E-SPN-0053's "every palindrome has a saddle" tested past its family, a STAND-IN instrument: it holds on...
purpose: Experiment E-SPN-0065 in the spin arena: E-SPN-0053's "every palindrome has a saddle" tested past its family, a STAND-IN instrument: it holds on the family x y z $P^a z y x P^b$ it was read from, and fails read broadly, since the 16-beat nested palindrome is a massive 3D bowl and x, y, y, x a planar bowl with g = 1; palindromes are bowls and saddles alike (85 and 240 in 3D), and the hypothesis that a 3D bowl is a bowl in every plane is refuted.
known_limitations: Depth L1 (L1: known mathematics, correctly confirmed).
